about_item: 【 12 Pack Battery Operated LED Fairy Lights 】- Powered by 2 CR2032 batteries (included), the 7 feet micro fairy light with 20 upgraded energy-efficient LEDs is perfect for both everyday decorations as well as holiday decor. The thin copper wiring and small-sized LED bulbs will add a delicate and cozy touch to your personal space

【 7ft Flexible Silver Wire 】- The starry moon fairy lights are made of a soft bendable silver wire. Easy to bend it to any shape or wrapped it on anything you want like photos, shelves, walls, mirrors, crafts, furnitures, wreaths, trees, branches, plants, flowers, or wedding déco

【 Long-Lasting Battery Life 】- Crafted with high-quality strong silver wire and energy-efficient LED bulbs lasting up to 2 years, these mini fairy lights are easy to use and safe to touch due to their low voltage. The included CR2032 watch batteries allow the lights to stay lit for more than 72 hours and can be quickly turned on or off via a simple button

【 Safe to Touch and Waterproof 】- The silver wire starry moon lights are low power and insulate heat, remaining safe to the touch. They run very cool, no need to worry about them overheating and damaging your home’s décor. Also, they are IP44 waterproof and can be taken outdoors as well. Enjoy these beautiful glowing mini fairy lights inside your bedroom or outdoors on your patios, or balconies

【 Wide Decorative Uses 】 Perfect fairy lights for weddings, parties, mason jars, crafts, arts, trees, branches, plants, flowers, kids’ rooms, tents, bedrooms, living rooms, nurseries, cubicles, loft beds, windows, ceilings, walls, shelves, patios, porches, balconies, corridors, fences, staircases, awnings, bulletin boards, holiday, Christmas, Ramadan decorations. A lovely gift for your family or friend who wants to spruce up their surroundings

authors_reviews.title: Great product!
authors_reviews.text: We used these lights for our wedding two days ago.We strung them up inside lanterns for the centerpieces for each table. Well, time got away from me and we just removed them from the car this afternoon.Guess what!!?? They’re still lit!!! Though they’re a little dim now, they’re still on!I’m giving these lights 5 stars because they’re certainly worth the money, they’re easy to turn on, the light color was bright enough but not too bright.Highly recommend!
authors_reviews.author: JRV

authors_reviews.title: Fairy lights
authors_reviews.text: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️These **Brightown 12-Pack LED Fairy Lights** are a delightful and versatile lighting set that brings charm and ambiance to any space or occasion!**✨ Beautiful Glow:** The warm LED lights give off a soft, cozy glow that instantly enhances the mood — perfect for decorating bedrooms, parties, weddings, holiday displays, or even DIY crafts.**🔋 Battery Operated:** Being battery powered makes these lights super flexible. You can place them anywhere — no outlet needed!**🌙 Flexible & Fun:** The silver wire is thin and bendable, so you can shape the lights however you like — around bottles, centerpieces, shelves, or wreaths.**💧 Waterproof Design:** They’re waterproof, which is great for both indoor and outdoor décor or seasonal settings.**🎉 12 Pack Value:** With 12 individual strings, you get plenty of lighting for multiple projects all at once. Ideal for table centerpieces, bedroom accents, or wrapping around décor elements.**🎨 DIY & Decorative Use:** Great for crafts, holidays (like Christmas or Halloween), special events, or everyday home style — these lights bring a whimsical, starry effect wherever you place them.Overall, a lovely and versatile set of string lights that’s worth the 5/5 — simple, charming, and perfect for lighting up your creativity! ✨🌟🎈

authors_reviews.author: Amazon Customer

authors_reviews.title: Versatile and bright for the price
authors_reviews.text: I bought this 12-pack of Brightown LED fairy lights to decorate around my patio, and I’m impressed. They feel like a steal for how many strands you get at the price.The battery pack isn't waterproof, so make sure that part is sheltered if using them outdoors.The wires are also very thin like any fairy lights, which is great for flexibility but means you have to handle them gently to avoid kinks or breaks.Because of the small battery size, if you run them a lot, you’ll need to swap batteries more often than with larger packs, but that’s pretty typical for battery fairy lights.Highly recommend if you want lots of high quality, small, bendable, battery-powered lights.
authors_reviews.author: Seth

authors_reviews.title: Look great on bikes
authors_reviews.text: Better than expected! While I doubt the battery holder is even water resistant, they look great on bike spokes and are significantly cheaper than the designed product... for short term use im sure but looked great on our camping trip. Simply used electrical tape to hold the battery holder to the inside of the spokes and did a si gle wrap of the wires around every other spoke, the wire being solid core wrapped nicely and held without issue

other_countries_reviews.title: Small, bright and beautiful led lights
other_countries_reviews.text: We put the lights up around the windows, the front door window, over and around potted plants, imitation miniature trees and in pumpkins for Hallowe'en. They're still shining after 20 hours so far, meaning the included replaceable battery life is good. The wires are flexible and strong, considering how fine they are and we shaped them into heart shapes 💕 and stars ✨ using tape in the plumpkins 🎃 🎃 and windows. With the range of colours in the set, these are practical all year round and in all seasons. I'll be adding them to wreaths for the door for any festive season; also around picture frames, over the potted plants, later onto the Christmas trees 🎄, around vases and seasonal ornaments. These are a bargain and I'll definitely order more; twelve is not enough! The colours are bright and true and it's hard to pick a favourite; green and purple looked great in the plumpkins and windows, blue, green, red and warm white would brighten Christmas. They'd bring a bit of cheer to any festival and they seem to be reasonably moisture proof so far too, being in two outdoor plumpkins 🎃 🎃.I like these lights very much. I highly recommend them and will buy more.
other_countries_reviews.author: Fluffy
